notes: This minor release raises the consumer requirement to Bifrost 0.15.3 or later. It is built by the released, checksum-pinned bifrost-semantic-pack 0.15.3 (public commit f7e104a77b4f869f342dd73af0cc622c4a1a0584, archive SHA-256 62a133b303783b51072433a933235172c4cbdb5baa6180c14a4dcdae91fd0379, executable SHA-256 31fd713a01021de631c95841c61327f1cb066ecb1e123992af39dc7b4205710f) instead of 0.15.1 (#311). Migration: the regenerated bifrost.rust-stdlib manifest uses semantic-model schema 40, so the bundle's semantic-model read schemas become 8, 14, 16, 19, 22 and 40, and Bifrost 0.15.2 and earlier reject the whole bundle ("unsupported semantic-model schema version 40", checked with the released 0.15.2 install-semantic-packs); stay on packs 0.14.0 with those engines. The release index schema stays 4 and the same 71 packs are listed with unchanged IDs and versions. Regenerated content: seven generated packs get new manifests from the new producer. bifrost.php-builtin is now certified callable-family complete (bifrost-dev#9337), so builtin sinks such as proc_open bind as complete; its shard is 4d5075c28ba2aafa4b56205874648b8e33a15f04c6094fa680ddff832194a803, reproduced locally in linux/amd64 Docker. bifrost.jdk, bifrost.rust-stdlib (producer 0.15.3+rust-pack-12, which contains bifrost-dev#12213, #12073 and #12364) and bifrost.scala-library change semantically. bifrost.kotlin-stdlib, bifrost.python-stdlib and bifrost.typescript-stdlib keep their semantic hashes; only the producer version and content hash change. bifrost.rust-stdlib stays review-required (see AGENTS.md). Source-only models added or changed in this repository are not in this native release: bifrost.ruby.net-imap 0.2.0, bifrost.node-fs-javascript-declarations 0.2.0 and -summaries 0.3.0, bifrost.node-vm-javascript-declarations 0.1.0 and bifrost.php-process-summaries 0.1.0. This release does not qualify every pack or imply complete analysis.
